blocks.tamil_translation: (with the Qur'an) strive against them with a mighty striving!

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (اُدْعُ إِلي سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet,) invite (people) to the way of your Rabb with wisdom and beautiful advice!

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ الذِّكْرَي تَنْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And keep advising! For surely advice benefits the believers.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ۞ قُمْ فَأَنْذِرْ۞ وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: O you who are wrapped up, arise! Then warn (the people)! And proclaim the greatness of your Rabb!

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet,) it seems you would destroy yourself (with grief) because they do not become believers (in Allah)!

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (لَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَؤُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (O people,) a Messenger from among yourselves has certainly come to you; your suffering is grievous to him; (that you may be guided and attain good) he is deeply
